mapper.select: SELECT * FROM biz_product_batch WHERE p_num = #{pNum} AND quality_status IN (0, 1) AND status = 0 AND quantity > 0 AND (quantity - locked_quantity) > 0 ORDER BY ${orderByClause}
SELECT * FROM biz_product_batch WHERE p_num = #{pNum} AND quality_status IN (0, 1) AND status = 0 AND quantity > 0 AND (quantity - locked_quantity) > 0 ORDER BY reserve_level DESC, expiry_date ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_product_batch SET quantity = quantity + #{rollbackAmount}, modified_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM biz_product_batch WHERE status = 0 AND quality_status IN (0, 1) AND expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND expiry_date <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY expiry_date ASC
SELECT p_num AS pNum, COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) AS totalQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(locked_quantity), 0) AS totalLocked FROM biz_product_batch WHERE status = 0 AND quality_status IN (0, 1) GROUP BY p_num
